hero.intro: I'm Felix Thomas Roy, a Computer Science graduate and Junior Application Developer with experience working on real-world mobile application development. I enjoy building practical software, solving technical problems, and continuously expanding my skills in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I am a Computer Science graduate with a strong interest in software development, mobile application development, and Artificial Intelligence.

I currently work as a Junior Application Developer at Navydo, a ride-hailing company, where I contribute to application feature development, testing, debugging, and collaborative software development.

My development experience includes working with Flutter and Dart for mobile applications, JavaScript and PostgreSQL for application-related development, and Git-based workflows for team collaboration.

Alongside my professional development experience, I am pursuing structured training in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. I have worked through Python, Object-Oriented Programming, data preprocessing, and several fundamental machine learning algorithms including Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors, Decision Trees, Support Vector Machines, AdaBoost, and Gradient Boosting.
I am particularly interested in combining software engineering with AI/ML to build useful, practical applications.

projects.title: IoT-Based Smart Food Surplus Redistribution System
projects.description: A final-year project designed to support the redistribution of surplus food using IoT technology and a Flutter-based donor application. The system combines mobile application development, IoT sensors, Firebase, location services, and hardware components to collect and manage food-related information.
projects.details: The system allows food donors to provide information about surplus food while IoT hardware captures relevant measurements such as weight and temperature. Location services associate food donations with geographical information, supporting the broader goal of connecting surplus food with redistribution opportunities.

projects.title: Food Waste Detection
projects.description: A machine learning project focused on identifying patterns related to food waste using a real-world dataset. The project explores data preprocessing, feature analysis, model training, evaluation, and prediction.

projects.title: SVM Classification Web App
projects.description: A beginner-to-intermediate machine learning classification project using Support Vector Machines. Demonstrates how numerical features can be scaled and passed into an SVM classifier to make predictions through a simple Streamlit interface.

projects.title: Titanic Survival Prediction
projects.description: A machine learning classification project based on the Titanic dataset. The application processes passenger information and predicts survival using a trained machine learning model with a Streamlit interface.
